items.title: Diamond Quatrefoil Lattice DXF Panel with Crosshatch Border
items.description: Diagonal crosshatch lines frame rows of four-lobed quatrefoil blooms and small punched circles, building a tight Moroccan-inspired lattice from top to bottom. Balanced and symmetrical, it suits entrance doors, balcony dividers, and boutique storefront screens.
